# RTS Subsets (Compared to ARTS)

## New RTS
```{r}
new_rts <- rts_poly |>
  filter(lengths(st_intersects(rts_poly, arts)) == 0)
```

## Shared RTS

```{r}
shared_rts_map <- rts_poly |>
  filter(lengths(st_intersects(rts_poly, arts)) >= 1)

shared_rts_obs <- arts |>
  filter(lengths(st_intersects(arts, rts_poly)) >= 1)
```

## Missed RTS

```{r}
missed_rts <- arts |>
  filter(lengths(st_intersects(arts, rts_poly)) == 0)
```

# Hex Grid Data Prep

## Create Hex Grid

```{r}
hex_grids <- map(
  c(100000, 50000, 10000),
  ~ domain |>
    st_make_grid(
      cellsize = sqrt((.x * 2) / (sqrt(3))) * 1000, # get short side length of hexagon from area == 100,000 km^2, and convert to m
      square = FALSE
    ) |>
    st_as_sf() |>
    rename(geometry = x) |>
    st_filter(domain) |>
    mutate(idx = 1:n())
)

names(hex_grids) <- c("hex_grid_100k", "hex_grid_50k", "hex_grid_10k")
```

## Extract Values

### RTS Counts

Get counts of mapped RTS, observed RTS (ARTS), shared RTS (base: mapped), shared RTS (base: observed/ARTS), new RTS, and missed RTS.

```{r}
hex_grids <- map(
  hex_grids,
  ~ .x |>
    # mapped RTS count
    left_join(
      rts_poly |>
        st_join(.x) |>
        st_drop_geometry() |>
        mutate(pp = (4 * pi * area_m2) / perimeter_m^2) |>
        summarise(
          rts_map_count = n(),
          rts_map_area = median(area_m2),
          rts_map_pp = median(pp),
          .by = idx
        ),
      by = "idx"
    ) |>
    # observed ARTS count
    left_join(
      arts |>
        st_join(.x) |>
        st_drop_geometry() |>
        summarise(
          arts_obs_count = n(),
          .by = idx
        ),
      by = "idx"
    ) |>
    # shared RTS count (base:mapped)
    left_join(
      shared_rts_map |>
        st_join(.x) |>
        st_drop_geometry() |>
        summarise(
          shared_rts_map_count = n(),
          .by = idx
        ),
      by = "idx"
    ) |>
    # shared RTS count (base:observed/ARTS)
    left_join(
      shared_rts_obs |>
        st_join(.x) |>
        st_drop_geometry() |>
        summarise(
          shared_rts_obs_count = n(),
          .by = idx
        ),
      by = "idx"
    ) |>
    # new RTS count
    left_join(
      new_rts |>
        st_join(.x) |>
        st_drop_geometry() |>
        summarise(
          new_rts_count = n(),
          .by = idx
        ),
      by = "idx"
    ) |>
    # missed RTS count
    left_join(
      missed_rts |>
        st_join(.x) |>
        st_drop_geometry() |>
        summarise(
          missed_rts_count = n(),
          .by = idx
        ),
      by = "idx"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      missed_rts_percent = missed_rts_count / arts_obs_count,
      new_rts_percent = new_rts_count / arts_obs_count,
      map_obs_ratio = rts_map_count / arts_obs_count,
      shared_count_ratio = shared_rts_obs_count / shared_rts_map_count,
      rts_map_count = case_when(
        is.na(rts_map_count) ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ rts_map_count
      ),
      arts_obs_count = case_when(
        is.na(arts_obs_count) ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ arts_obs_count
      ),
      .before = geometry
    )
)
```

### RTS Probability

```{r}
hex_grids <- map(
  hex_grids,
  ~ terra::extract(
    rts_prob,
    .x,
    fun = max,
    na.rm = TRUE,
    ID = FALSE,
    bind = TRUE
  ) |>
    st_as_sf() |>
    mutate(
      rts_prob = case_when(
        !is.nan(median) ~ median,
        TRUE ~ NA
      )
    ) |>
    select(-median)
)
```

## Classify Values

Take a look at distribution of counts and areas - consider a log scale for color ramps on these.

```{r}
map(
  hex_grids,
  function(.x) {
    list(
      # RTS Count (Mapped)
      ggplot(data = .x) +
        geom_histogram(aes(x = rts_map_count)) +
        scale_x_continuous(trans = "log10"),

      # ARTS Count (Observed)
      ggplot(data = .x) +
        geom_histogram(aes(x = arts_obs_count)) +
        scale_x_continuous(trans = "log10"),

      # RTS Count (Mapped)
      ggplot(data = .x) +
        geom_histogram(aes(x = rts_prob))
    )
  }
)
```

```{r}
count_breaks <- map(
  hex_grids,
  ~ list(
    "rts_map_count" = c(
      0,
      quantile(
        .x |>
          filter(rts_map_count != 0) |>
          pull(rts_map_count),
        probs = c(0.5, 0.8, 0.95, 1)
      )
    ),
    "arts_obs_count" = c(
      0,
      quantile(
        .x |>
          filter(arts_obs_count != 0) |>
          pull(arts_obs_count),
        probs = c(0.5, 0.8, 0.95, 1)
      )
    ),
    "rts_prob" = c(
      0,
      quantile(
        .x |>
          filter(rts_prob != 0) |>
          pull(rts_prob),
        probs = c(0.5, 0.8, 0.95, 1)
      ) |>
        round(2)
    )
  )
)
```

```{r}
hex_grids <- map2(
  hex_grids,
  count_breaks,
  ~ .x |>
    mutate(
      rts_map_count_class = classify_counts(
        rts_map_count,
        breaks = .y$rts_map_count
      ),
      arts_obs_count_class = classify_counts(
        arts_obs_count,
        breaks = .y$arts_obs_count
      ),
      rts_prob_class = classify_counts(
        rts_prob,
        breaks = .y$rts_prob
      ),
      map_obs_offset = rts_map_count_class - arts_obs_count_class,
      map_prob_offset = rts_map_count_class - rts_prob_class,
      .before = geometry
    ) |>
    rowwise() |>
    mutate(
      bi_class_arts = str_flatten(
        c(rts_map_count_class, arts_obs_count_class),
        collapse = "-"
      ),
      bi_class_prob = str_flatten(
        c(rts_map_count_class, rts_prob_class),
        collapse = "-"
      ),
      .before = geometry
    ) |>
    ungroup()
)
```

# Regional Stats

```{r}
region_stats <- map2(
  hex_grids,
  count_breaks,
  ~ regions |>
    st_join(.x) |>
    summarise(
      across(
        !contains("class") & !contains("idx"),
        list(mean = mean, sd = sd),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      .by = c(name, X, Y, geometry)
    ) |>
    mutate(
      rts_map_count_class = classify_counts(
        rts_map_count_mean,
        breaks = .y$rts_map_count
      ),
      rts_map_count_class_sd = rts_map_count_sd /
        (.y$rts_map_count[rts_map_count_class + 1] -
          .y$rts_map_count[rts_map_count_class]),
      arts_obs_count_class = classify_counts(
        arts_obs_count_mean,
        breaks = .y$arts_obs_count
      ),
      arts_obs_count_class_sd = arts_obs_count_sd /
        (.y$arts_obs_count[arts_obs_count_class + 1] -
          .y$arts_obs_count[arts_obs_count_class]),
      rts_prob_class = classify_counts(
        rts_prob_mean,
        breaks = .y$rts_prob
      ),
      rts_prob_class_sd = rts_prob_sd /
        (.y$rts_prob[rts_prob_class + 1] -
          .y$rts_prob[rts_prob_class]),
      map_obs_offset = rts_map_count_class - arts_obs_count_class,
      map_obs_offset_sd = sqrt(
        rts_map_count_class_sd^2 + arts_obs_count_class_sd^2
      ),
      map_prob_offset = rts_map_count_class - rts_prob_class,
      map_prob_offset_sd = sqrt(
        rts_map_count_class_sd^2 + rts_prob_class_sd^2
      ),
      .before = geometry
    ) |>
    rowwise() |>
    mutate(
      bi_class_arts = str_flatten(
        c(rts_map_count_class, arts_obs_count_class),
        collapse = "-"
      ),
      bi_class_prob = str_flatten(
        c(rts_map_count_class, rts_prob_class),
        collapse = "-"
      ),
      .before = geometry
    ) |>
    ungroup()
)
```

## Mapping Data Subsets
Take a look at various subsets of the total dataset. Counts: total mapped RTS count, total ARTS observed count, shared RTS count (base: mapped), shared RTS count (base: observed), new RTS count, missed RTS count. Percents (relative to ARTS observed count): new RTS percent, missed RTS percent, mapped to observed ratio.

```{r}
hex_maps <- map2(
  hex_grids,
  hex_domains,
  function(.x, .y) {
    list(
      ### Data Subsets
      # RTS Count (Mapped)
      map_hex_grid(
        .x,
        .y,
        variable = "rts_map_count",
        label = "RTS Count\n(Mapped)",
        transformation = "log10"
      ),

      # ARTS Count (Observed)
      map_hex_grid(
        .x,
        .y,
        variable = "arts_obs_count",
        label = "ARTS Count\n(Observed)",
        transformation = "log10"
      ),

      # Shared RTS Count (base: mapped)
      map_hex_grid(
        .x,
        .y,
        variable = "shared_rts_map_count",
        label = "Shared RTS\nCount\n(Mapped)",
        transformation = "log10"
      ),

      # Shared RTS Count (base: observed)
      map_hex_grid(
        .x,
        .y,
        variable = "shared_rts_obs_count",
        label = "Shared RTS\nCount\n(Observed)",
        transformation = "log10"
      ),

      # New RTS Count
      map_hex_grid(
        .x,
        .y,
        variable = "new_rts_count",
        label = "New RTS\nCount",
        transformation = "log10"
      ),

      # Missed RTS Count
      map_hex_grid(
        .x,
        .y,
        variable = "missed_rts_count",
        label = "Missed RTS\nCount",
        transformation = "log10"
      ),

      ### Dataset Comparison (Ratios and Percents)
      # New RTS Percent
      # Blue means we found more new RTS than we already knew about, red means we found fewer new RTS than we already knew about
      map_hex_grid(
        .x,
        .y,
        variable = "new_rts_percent",
        color_scale = scale_color_gradient2,
        fill_scale = scale_fill_gradient2,
        label = "New RTS\n(Percent)",
        transformation = "log10"
      ),

      # Missed RTS percent
      map_hex_grid(
        .x,
        .y,
        variable = "missed_rts_percent",
        label = "Missed RTS\n(Percent)",
        transformation = "identity"
      ),

      # Mapped to Observed Ratio
      # Blue means we found more RTS (total, not just new) than we already knew about, red means we found fewer RTS (total, not just new) than we already knew about
      map_hex_grid(
        .x,
        .y,
        variable = "map_obs_ratio",
        color_scale = scale_color_gradient2,
        fill_scale = scale_fill_gradient2,
        label = "Mapped to\nObserved Ratio",
        transformation = "log10"
      )
    )
  }
)

hex_maps
```

### Offset Between Mapped RTS Count and ARTS Observations Count

#### Univariate Maps
Blue indicates we found a lot of RTS in a low probability area, while red indicates we found fewer RTS than the probability would indicate.

```{r}
count_arts_maps <- map2(
  hex_grids,
  hex_domains,
  function(.x, .y) {
    map_hex_grid(
      .x,
      .y,
      variable = "map_obs_offset",
      label = "Mapped RTS Count/\nARTS Observation Offset"
    ) +
      geom_sf(
        data = regions,
        color = "black",
        fill = "transparent",
        linetype = "dashed"
      ) +
      geom_sf_text(
        data = regions,
        aes(label = name)
      ) +
      scale_color_gradient2(
        name = "Mapped RTS Count/\nARTS Observation Offset",
        na.value = "transparent",
        limits = c(-4, 4)
      ) +
      scale_fill_gradient2(
        name = "Mapped RTS Count/\nARTS Observation Offset",
        na.value = "transparent",
        limits = c(-4, 4)
      ) +
      theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.direction = "horizontal"
      ) +
      coord_sf(expand = FALSE)
  }
)

count_arts_maps
```

## Mapped RTS Counts vs RTS Probability

### Bivariate Maps
Redder colors indicate more RTS were mapped than predicted, while bluer colors indicate fewer RTS were mapped than predicted.

```{r}
bi_legend_location <- c(
  left = 0.81,
  bottom = 0,
  right = 1,
  top = 0.145
)

hex_maps_bi_prob <- pmap(
  list(hex_grids, hex_domains, count_breaks),
  function(grid, domain, breaks) {
    filtered_grid <- grid |>
      filter(!is.na(bi_class_prob))

    map_hex_grid_bi(
      filtered_grid,
      "bi_class_prob",
      "rts_map_count",
      "rts_prob",
      domain,
      5,
      breaks$rts_map_count,
      round(breaks$rts_prob, 2),
      custom_palette_5,
      legend_loc = bi_legend_location,
      xlab = "RTS Count (Mapped)",
      ylab = "RTS Probability"
    )
  }
)

hex_maps_bi_prob
```

### Offset Between Mapped RTS Count and RTS Probability

#### Univariate Maps
Blue indicates we found a lot of RTS in a low probability area, while red indicates we found fewer RTS than the probability would indicate.

```{r}
count_prob_maps <- map2(
  hex_grids,
  hex_domains,
  function(.x, .y) {
    map_hex_grid(
      .x,
      .y,

      geom_sf(

)
```

# Why are Not-Missed and Shared numbers so different?
Try dividing shared count (observed) by shared count (modeled) and mapping the results to look for places with high values.

```{r}
map2(
  hex_grids,
  hex_domains,
  ~ map_hex_grid(
    .x,
    .y,
    "shared_count_ratio",
    label = "Ratio of Shared RTS Count\n(Observed to Modeled)",
    transformation = "log10"
  )
)

ggplot(hex_grids[["hex_grid_10k"]]) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = rts_modeled_area, y = shared_count_ratio)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log10")
```

Following visual inspection of the island in Russia with the exceptionally high value, it looks like our model was an RTS "lumper" while the lab that created the entries for ARTS subscribed to an RTS "splitter" philosophy. The model only identified a few very large RTS along the coast, while the labels split features that are contiguous into sub-RTS with borders that touched (or very nearly so).
